facts.fact: BCEAO instruction n008-05-2015 of 21 May 2015 sets the e-money framework applying in Burkina Faso, per L'Economiste du Faso.
Burkina's legislative assembly adopted on 26 June 2026 a bank regulation bill extending banking law to payment institutions and e-money institutions, awaiting promulgation and entry into force.
facts.system: Projet de loi portant reglementation bancaire

facts.fact: L'Economiste du Faso says non-bank actors such as fintechs can obtain a BCEAO e-money institution approval, and Orange Money Burkina Faso holds it.
